text.en: PaLM-E is row 37 of the BenchCouncil AI100 (2022-2023) annual table in the LLM area.
text.zh: PaLM-E 是 BenchCouncil AI100（2022-2023）年度表第 37 行，所属领域为“大语言模型”。

text.en: The annual table associates PaLM-E with “Palm-e: An embodied multimodal language model”.
text.zh: 年度表把 PaLM-E 与论文《Palm-e: An embodied multimodal language model》关联。

text.en: The Main Contributors field is “Danny Driess, Pete Florence”.
text.zh: “主要人物”字段依次列出 丹尼·德里斯、皮特·弗洛伦斯；官方英文原文为“Danny Driess, Pete Florence”。

text.en: PaLM-E maps continuous sensor observations into embeddings that are interleaved with text tokens for a pretrained language model.
text.zh: PaLM-E 把连续传感器观察映射为嵌入，并与文本 token 交错输入预训练语言模型。

text.en: The paper reports positive transfer across embodied, vision-language and language tasks as model scale increases.
text.zh: 论文报告随着模型规模增加，具身、视觉语言与语言任务之间出现正向迁移。
